arguments.content: Research checkpoint is ready for review at /Users/normy/autobyteus_org/autobyteus-worktrees/universal-application-framework-proposal-analysis/applications/brief-studio/.autobyteus/dev/data/applications/bundle-app__7374616e64616c6f6e65__62726965662d73747564696f/runtime/brief-studio/research.md. Key findings: define a controlled shutdown that separates publication intake from graph reads/construction; freeze intake, drain/cancel in-flight work, verify queues/workers, then disable publishing; require idempotent controls, auditability, explicit status, and last-known-good snapshot retention; make restart/replay reversible. Open questions include topology/queue semantics, consumer consistency expectations, and RTO/RPO plus authorization/notification requirements. Please review this file before drafting the brief.
